text: Gazprom Neft is part of the Gazprom Group; the group owns about 96% of Gazprom Neft's shares.
short: Gazprom Group owns about 96% of Gazprom Neft.

source.name: AK&M Information Agency: Hungarian MOL and Serbian government sign NIS agreement
source.quote: The company is part of the Gazprom Group, which owns about 96% of the shares
source.note: The sentence refers to Gazprom Neft PJSC in the article's profile paragraph. The same AK&M piece reports Gazprom Neft is a subsidiary of NIS's parent chain and was sanctioned in 2025.

additionalSources.name: Global Banking & Finance Review (carrying a Reuters dispatch): Russia's Gazprom Neft provisionally agrees to sell NIS stake to Hungary's MOL
additionalSources.quote: Russia's Gazprom holds an 11.3% stake in NIS, while its sanctioned oil unit Gazprom Neft owns 44.9%
